findings.title: <memory> fence from render_markdown_v1 not in DISCARD_TAG_PAIRS
findings.description: MessageAssembler builds its scrubber with DISCARD_TAG_PAIRS, which excludes the <memory>...</memory> outer fence and the six inner slot fences (<user_profile>, <session_recent>, etc.) that the production MarkdownV1 render style emits. If the LLM echoes the framing back, the terminal sanitize path also lacks coverage, so raw <memory>...</memory> tags reach the user.
findings.suggested_fix: Add MarkdownV1 fences to DISCARD_TAG_PAIRS (or have the scrubber read RenderStyle at construction time) and extend OTHER_STRIP_TAGS in sanitize.rs to match. Extend the discard_tag_pairs_*_matches_canonical_fence drift-guard test to cover all the fences.

findings.title: Dreaming stages never call push_pending; queue is ingest-only
findings.description: embedding_manager.rs:25 docstring claims 'Producers (ingest tail, dream stage tails) are wired in B5.2' but only the ingest tail (notes/ingest/ingestor/batch.rs:230-241) calls push_pending/flush_pending. 10+ dream stages (note_decay, note_consolidate, note_synthesis, note_lint, note_review, mention_weave, note_weave, goal_lessons_promote, dreaming/mod.rs:2498) all write notes and bypass the queue, leaving vectors stale until manual reembed_all RPC.
findings.suggested_fix: Either wire a background flusher task (as the docstring promises) and have every stage tail push_pending, or remove the queue and re-embed on the read path.

findings.title: Three extract_depth copies with different first/last /d semantics
findings.description: mod.rs:137 (split('/d').nth(1) — first), summary_source.rs:135 (split('/').find_map strip_prefix('d') — first d-segment), session_search_summary/end_hook.rs:34 (rfind('/d') — last) all parse aleph://session/{sid}/d{depth}/{seq} but give different answers when session_id contains '/d'. The end_hook copy is the only one with a documented correct invariant.
findings.suggested_fix: Promote the end_hook.rs:34 version to session_compactor::extract_depth and delete both copies.

findings.title: call_api has no retry, no backoff, no Retry-After parsing
findings.description: A single HTTP request. Any non-2xx response or network error becomes AlephError::config that flush_pending catches and drops the batch. No retry, no exponential backoff, no circuit breaker. A single 503 from the remote provider drops an entire ingest batch's embeddings. Combined with F-02, transient errors on the dream-tail path mean vectors stay absent permanently.
findings.suggested_fix: Wrap request.send() in a small retry loop with exponential backoff honoring Retry-After. Distinguish transient (5xx, network) from configuration (4xx) errors so flush_pending can push transient-failed items back to the queue front rather than drop them.

findings.title: Embedding signature uses config id, not preset
findings.description: format!('{provider_id}:{model_name}:{dim}') uses the user's config id, but two different ids (e.g. openai-prod, openai-dev) on the same preset produce different signatures, forcing a full reembed when the actual weights are unchanged. Conversely, two providers with the same id (from different machines) write the same signature even if they point at different weights.
findings.suggested_fix: Sign the preset as well: format!('{preset}:{p}:{m}:{d}'). One extra lookup at record time, avoids unnecessary reembeds on operator rename.

findings.title: aggregate_tool_usage and aggregate_tool_failures may double-read ToolInvocation rows
findings.description: Tool-signal-sink module doc identifies exactly two readers of RawMemorySource::ToolInvocation: aggregate_tool_usage (admin RPC) and aggregate_tool_failures (tool_failure_distill dream stage). If one consumer marks rows processed and the other then sees an empty set, the failure distiller silently stops seeing failures.
findings.suggested_fix: Audit whether mark_raw_as_processed covers ToolInvocation rows on both paths. Add a per-consumer cursor if it does, or a processed_by watermark.

findings.title: EnvelopeRelevanceFloorExtension registered with floor=0.0 (no-op)
findings.description: agent_init/mod.rs:319-322 registers the extension with new(0.0). The comment at 317-318 says 'no-op at floor=0.0 to prove end-to-end plumbing. Real floor could be plumbed from config later.' The registration consumes a slot in the registry and the per-call extension-chain walk adds latency for zero observable behaviour.
findings.suggested_fix: Either plumb the floor from [memory.orientation]/[memory.extensions] envelope_floor config, or gate the registration behind 'if cfg.envelope_floor > 0.0' so the empty chain is only assembled when there is something to do. Per R10 YAGNI, prefer the gate.

findings.title: note_type_as_str_values_are_unique misses 4 of 15 variants
findings.description: arb_note_type generates 15 variants (Lesson, Skill, Reference, Transcript added after Preference, Plan, ...). The deterministic note_type_as_str_values_are_unique test lists only 11. The proptest covers all 15 today, but a future contributor adding a variant who only updates arb_note_type will silently leave the deterministic test out of date.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the hand-listed all_variants with a const fn enumerating the enum (or derive strum::EnumIter), or guard with 'assert_eq!(all_variants.len(), 15)' so a missing entry is a loud failure.

findings.title: pending field docstring claims a background flush task that does not exist
findings.description: The docstring says 'the background flush task drains in batches via flush_pending (wired in B5.2)'. No tokio::spawn exists, no task handle field, no test for flush-without-push. The B5.2 marker at agent_init/mod.rs:185-186 is a different concern (hoisting the manager out of local scope).
findings.suggested_fix: Either implement the background task the docstring promises, or rewrite the docstring to describe the actual producer/consumer. Downstream of F-02.

findings.title: Stage lists live in mod.rs::from_strategy, not strategy.rs
findings.description: strategy.rs is 58 lines of mostly re-exports; the per-strategy stage lists are in dreaming/mod.rs::from_strategy (a ~100-line vec![Box::new(...)] block). Moving the lists into strategy.rs would shorten from_strategy and make the three strategies diffable.
findings.suggested_fix: Add impl DreamStrategy { fn stage_list(&self, cfg, policy) -> Vec<Box<dyn DreamStage>> } in strategy.rs and have from_strategy call through. Mechanical, low risk.

findings.title: RippleTask default shape not explicitly tested
findings.description: RippleConfig has an explicit test; RippleTask (task.rs) does not. Field-level reader-vs-writer coverage is plausibly complete (one quick scan) but the test gap is real. Worth a follow-up grep-diff pass.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a one-line test for RippleTask::default() shape, mirroring the existing RippleConfig test.
